description: Defines the IOProfile class and related classes for managing audio input/output stream capabilities and device support in Android's audio policy framework.

classes.name: IOProfile
classes.description: Represents an audio input/output profile with capabilities, device support, and compatibility checks.

classes.name: InputProfile
classes.description: Specialization of IOProfile for input streams.

classes.name: OutputProfile
classes.description: Specialization of IOProfile for output streams.

methods.name: IOProfile(const std::string &name, audio_port_role_t role)
methods.description: Constructor for IOProfile, initializes with name and role.

methods.name: ~IOProfile()
methods.description: Default destructor.

methods.name: getTagName()
methods.description: Returns the tag name, which is the same as the profile name.

methods.name: addAudioProfile(const sp<AudioProfile> &profile)
methods.description: Adds an audio profile to the profile's list.

methods.name: asAudioPort()
methods.description: Returns this profile as an AudioPort pointer.

methods.name: setFlags(uint32_t flags)
methods.description: Sets flags for the profile, affecting maxActiveCount and mixer behaviors.

methods.name: getMixerBehaviors()
methods.description: Returns the set of mixer behaviors for this profile.

methods.name: isCompatibleProfile(...)
methods.description: Checks if the profile is compatible with given device parameters.

methods.name: areAllDevicesSupported(const DeviceVector &devices)
methods.description: Checks if all specified devices are supported.

methods.name: isCompatibleProfileForFlags(uint32_t flags, bool exactMatchRequired)
methods.description: Checks if profile is compatible with specific flags.

methods.name: dump(String8 *dst, int spaces)
methods.description: Outputs profile details for debugging.

methods.name: log()
methods.description: Logs profile details.

methods.name: supportsDeviceTypes(const DeviceTypeSet& deviceTypes)
methods.description: Checks if profile supports given device types.

methods.name: getTag(const DeviceTypeSet& deviceTypes)
methods.description: Returns tag name of first matching device type.

methods.name: supportsDevice(const sp<DeviceDescriptor> &device, bool forceCheckOnAddress)
methods.description: Checks if a specific device is supported.

methods.name: devicesSupportEncodedFormats(DeviceTypeSet deviceTypes)
methods.description: Checks if devices support encoded formats.

methods.name: containsSingleDeviceSupportingEncodedFormats(const sp<DeviceDescriptor>& device)
methods.description: Checks if a single device supports encoded formats.

methods.name: clearSupportedDevices()
methods.description: Clears the list of supported devices.

methods.name: addSupportedDevice(const sp<DeviceDescriptor> &device)
methods.description: Adds a device to supported list.

methods.name: removeSupportedDevice(const sp<DeviceDescriptor> &device)
methods.description: Removes a device from supported list.

methods.name: setSupportedDevices(const DeviceVector &devices)
methods.description: Sets the list of supported devices.

methods.name: getSupportedDevices()
methods.description: Returns the list of supported devices.

methods.name: canOpenNewIo()
methods.description: Checks if a new IO stream can be opened.

methods.name: canStartNewIo()
methods.description: Checks if a new active IO stream can be started.

methods.name: toSupportedMixerAttributes(std::vector<audio_mixer_attributes_t>* mixerAttributes)
methods.description: Converts profile to mixer attributes.
